importantNotes: Joel 2:28-32 is quoted by Peter at Pentecost (Acts 2:16-21) — the outpouring of the Spirit.
'I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten' (2:25) — a beloved promise.
'Rend your heart, not your garments' (2:13) — God wants inner repentance, not outward show.
The Day of the LORD is a major prophetic theme — judgment and salvation.
Joel bridges the gap between judgment and grace — both are fully displayed.

chapters.1: A devastating locust plague destroys the land; Joel calls for mourning and fasting.
chapters.2: The Day of the LORD is near — like an invading army; a call to repent; God promises restoration and His Spirit.
chapters.3: Judgment on the nations in the Valley of Jehoshaphat; the LORD dwells in Zion.
